itemList.title: Low average age
itemList.desc: The average in the Philippines is around 25 years old, which means that there is a lot of youthful energy available for work.

itemList.title: Cost-effective high quality labor
itemList.desc: Although it may cost less to hire Filipino workers than locals, there will be no sacrifice in the quality of work. In fact, Filipinos who work abroad tend to work even harder than locals because of their feelings of gratitude and urgency to perform.

itemList.title: Low minimum wage
itemList.desc: The minimum wage in the Philippines is around $200 USD/month. This fact has driven Filipinos to find employment in foreign countries. They work extremely hard because they feel blessed to be earning higher wages abroad.

itemList.title: Well-known as People who work abroad
itemList.desc: There are Filipinos all over the world from Europe to the Middle East, North America, and all across Asia. Filipino workers have been known to be hard-working, friendly, and loyal to their employers.

itemList.title: English Speaking
itemList.desc: The demand for workers who are competent in the English language is growing with the rise of Globalization. The English language is especially important in the hotel and restaurant industry. Almost all Filipinos are proficient in English and are happy to share and utilize their skills.

corporateIdentity.title: About Us
corporateIdentity.subtitle: Corporate Identity
corporateIdentity.placewellInternational: Placewell International is a Filipino-owned, family-run manpower agency with over 50 years of experience in deploying Filipino workers overseas. Headquartered in Makati and supported by more than 15 branches nationwide, we recruit, train, and deploy Filipino workers to companies all over the world. Placewell is committed to providing its clients with dependable workers and service that is efficient, organized and highly responsive. At the same time, Placewell remains dedicated to empowering Filipinos by connecting them with employers that value them as people.
corporateIdentity.chiefDesc: They are the husband and wife team that founded Placewell International and are pioneers in the Philippine overseas employment industry. Aida continues to provide dedicated service to her long-standing clients in the Middle East, even into her 90s.
corporateIdentity.viceDesc: Elo took over Placewell International in 1995 and has since transformed the company into one of the country’s leading manpower agencies. She is a seasoned businesswoman with a big heart. Under her leadership, Placewell has expanded its services across Europe, Asia, Oceania, and North America. She obtained her degree in Psychology from Colegio de San Juan de Letran.
corporateIdentity.consultantDesc: Joelo is a licensed attorney and a JLPT N1 passer. He obtained his degree in International Business from Pepperdine University and his Juris Doctor from Ateneo De Manila School of Law. He is also the President of Hashira Skills and Language Academy and Pro-Tech Skills Development Center Corporation. He has been with Placewell since 2018.
corporateIdentity.missionDesc: To be the most trusted, most reliable Philippine manpower services company in the world, recognized for readily available efficient services to our clients; for loyalty to our employees; for fidelity to our stockholders; and for social responsibility to our community.
corporateIdentity.visionDesc: A Philippine manpower services company, born of excellence, nurtured by expertise, and committed to leading in meeting the needs of global employers for highly competent, professional, and skilled Filipino workers.

corporatePhilosophy.line1: We are a people company that builds lasting relationships.
corporatePhilosophy.line2: We care for people because they are:

reasons.1: Individuals with dignity to be respected and rights to be protected.
reasons.3: Workers who need to be treated and rewarded fairly.

corporatePhilosophy.clientsDesc: We exist for our clients and, thus, work to provide them with on-time job-ready, and competent workers as required, by employing only ethical and modern recruitment practices and strategies that conform to international standards.
corporatePhilosophy.csrTitle: We take our corporate social responsibility seriously.
corporatePhilosophy.csrDesc: We share the rewards of business with the communities where we operate, believing that by giving freely, you shall receive tenfold.

ourServices.title: About Us
ourServices.subtitle: Our Services
ourServices.desc: From Skills and Language Training to Trade Tests – we do it all!
ourServices.recruitmentDesc: We source qualified workers through our network of over 15 branches nationwide, supported by a strong and active social media presence. In addition, our established reputation in the industry enables us to receive support from government agencies in identifying and recruiting highly qualified candidates.
ourServices.screeningDesc: We carefully screen candidates based on their work experience, qualifications, personality and English proficiency to ensure that our clients only interview qualified and outstanding workers
ourServices.interviewDesc: We have comfortable interview rooms and conduct interviews in an organized and professional manner. All applicants use a standard resume format for consistency. We also ensure that online interviews are conducted smoothly and with equally good quality.
ourServices.tradeTestDesc: We conduct trade tests across various industries at our own in-house facility.
ourServices.skillAndLangDesc: We have a dedicated school for Japanese language training, as well as separate facilities for Arabic and Cantonese language modules. In addition, we operate our own TESDA accredited training center.
ourServices.immigrationDesc: For OFW destinations requiring immigration interviews, such as Lithuania, we provide candidates with mock interview sessions where our staff simulate the role of immigration officers to help them prepare effectively. Pre-Departure Orientation - An accredited provider since 1988, Placewell conducts the government-required Pre-Departure Orientation Seminar (PDOS) in its own facility. This one-day seminar prepares selected candidates by providing essential information about their destination country and useful advice about working abroad.
ourServices.deploymentDesc: We transport our workers to the airport, ensuring they arrive on time for their flights. Prior to departure, we orient them on all necessary airport procedures, both local and international.
ourServices.postDeploymentDesc: We have a dedicated OFW welfare division and a 24/7 call center to support workers who may experience distress while abroad.
ourServices.myraDesc: Myra is Placewell’s personalized manpower support system that ensures all selected workers’ relevant information and documents are properly organized, upholding an accurate and timely deployment process. It also maintains a readily available pool of candidates across various industries, with filters for quick and easy searching and sorting. Placewell also provides employers with their own personalized Myra accounts, offering customized features tailored to their specific industry needs.
ourServices.whatsAup: WhatsApp and Line Group Chat System
ourServices.whatsAupDesc: To ensure fast and efficient communication with all our partners and clients, we use a group chat system managed by our dedicated staff. We prioritize quick and accurate responses, recognizing the importance of time in the recruitment process.
ourServices.whatsAppGroupDesc: Instant messaging and updates for smooth communication
ourServices.lineGroupDesc: Organized group chats for better coordination and collaboration.
ourServices.facebookDesc: With nearly 500,000 Facebook followers, we generate hundreds of qualified applicants from a single post. Our dedicated manpower support team thoroughly screens every candidate before presenting them to clients — saving you time and ensuring only the best reach your interview table.

worldWide.desc: Over 200,000 Filipinos deployed to more than 30 different countries
worldWide.constructionDesc: From construction sites to shipyards and highways, this skilled professionals build, operate, and maintain the structures and systems that keep the world moving forward.

and training of welders across all

types of welding. We deploy skilled

workers to Japan, particularly in Imabari,

including placements at

worldWide.truckingDesc:
We implement a specialized recruitment

system for truck drivers bound for Lithuania.

We maintain a pool of pre-documented

worldWide.hospitalityDesc: These professionals ensure people feel comportable, safe and cared for --whether at home, in hotels, on flights, or in the places where we gather and relax.
worldWide.cleardersDesc: Our highest-volume job order is the deployment of on-call cleaners to Saudi Arabia.
worldWide.domesticDesc: Placewell is recognized as a leading Philippine manpower agency for deploying domestic helpers to Hong Kong. We also deploy place domestic helpers in the Middle East, Singapore, Malaysia, Mongolia, and Italy.

worldWide.flight: Flight Attendants and Ground Handling staff
worldWide.flightDesc: We are a provider of flight attendants and ground handling staff for Kuwait Airways.
worldWide.medicalDesc: These healthcare professionals provide essential medical care, support, and treatment --helping individuals live healthier, happier lives.
worldWide.nursesDesc: We have deployed numerous nurses to hospitals in Saudi Arabia, including the Ministry of National Guard Health Affairs and Saudi German Hospital.We have also placed hundreds of nurses in hospitals across the United States.
worldWide.caregiversDesc: We were among the first manpower agencies to deploy caregivers to Japan under the Technical Intern Training Program.We also deploy caregivers to Taiwan and SingaporeSaudi Arabia.

department.desc: Discover how we deliver streamlined operations
department.internationalDesc: We assign dedicated contact persons for each market we serve. They maintain constant communication with our clients through a group chat system, ensuring timely and accurate responses for an efficient deployment process. We have designated departments for the Middle East, Europe, Japan, Hong Kong, and other Asian countries.
department.manpowerDesc: The Manpower Support Team is responsible for recruiting workers and coordinating interview schedules. They screen applicants, verify qualifications, and arrange interviews with employers. The team also manages and maintains a database of tens of thousands of qualified Filipino workers within our Myra System.
department.ofwDesc: Placewell prioritizes the welfare of its deployed workers through ongoing support and care. Our dedicated call center operates nearly 24/7 to promptly address concerns and provide assistance to distressed workers abroad.
department.processDesc: Our dedicated team handles all required documentation efficiently and accurately to ensure minimal delays in the deployment process.
department.accountingDesc: We maintain disciplined and organized financial management across all operations.
